integrations.subtitle: Every connector goes through the same adapter: plugging one in does not change the screens. Without a connected account, everything goes through the simulated connector.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: Matrix enforced by Postgres (RLS). Click a letter to grant or revoke the permission (immediate effect, logged). R = read, C = create, U = update, D = delete, E = export.
roles.footer: Database safeguards: only HR and management can grant salary access; nobody can remove permission administration from their own role. Every change is recorded in the audit log. The sector profile remains the source of the seed.

privacy.title: Personal data (GDPR)
privacy.subtitle: Right of access, records, access to sensitive data
privacy.accessHint: JSON export of all of an employee's data (record, badges, leave, hours, expense reports, reviews, training). Salary is only included if your role has access to it (RLS).
privacy.noReveals: No views since the last reset.

security.title: Account security
security.subtitle: Two-factor authentication with an app (TOTP: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…)
security.wrongCodeHint: Check your phone's clock and try again.
security.enabledHint: The code will be requested at every sign-in.
security.recommended: Recommended for roles that see salaries or finance.
security.scan: 1. Scan this QR code with your app.
security.how1: • At sign-in, after the password, the app's 6-digit code is requested.
security.how2: • Until the code is entered, no page or API is accessible (checked server-side).
security.how3: • The secret is stored by the authentication service, never by the application.

automations.title: Automations
automations.subtitle: “When … then …”: event rules run in real time; date and threshold rules are evaluated on demand (pg_cron scheduling in phase 4).
